endCondition.description: When a player reaches 15 medals or fills their engine room, finish the round and play one more full round (triggering player starts it).

notes: family: running-track. Medals come from flights, development, waiting, route/goal missions; point values are tracked on the medal gauge during play, so only the final gauge position is entered. Final-round conversion of leftover resources and mission ranks into Exploration steps can still add medals. Exact tiebreaker and conversion details not verified (official CMON rulebook PDF could not be downloaded; sources are product pages and Japanese reviews).
